bio: Jennifer Hochschild is the Henry LaBarre Jayne Professor of Government at Harvard University, Professor of African and African American Studies, and Harvard College Professor. In 2011, she held the John R. Kluge Chair in American Law and Governance at the Library of Congress, and in 2013-14, she was a Fellow of The Straus Institute for the Advanced Study of Law & Justice, New York University School of Law. She holds lectureships in the Harvard Kennedy School and Harvard Graduate School of Education.
